```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
from pathlib import Path

# Look for disclosure-controlled aggregate payload in outputs/private or outputs/release
possible_paths = [
    Path("../../outputs/private/interactive_cohort_summary.json"),
    Path("../outputs/private/interactive_cohort_summary.json"),
    Path("outputs/private/interactive_cohort_summary.json"),
    Path("../../outputs/release/interactive_cohort_summary.json"),
]

data_file = None
for p in possible_paths:
    if p.exists():
        data_file = p
        break

if data_file and data_file.exists():
    with open(data_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        payload = json.load(f)
else:
    # Fallback to safe pre-aggregated synthetic records
    payload = {
        "metadata": {
            "title": "Default Synthetic Aggregate",
            "small_cell_threshold": 5,
            "disclosure_control_applied": True,
        },
        "data": [
            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "M", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "<55", "n_patients": 9, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 22.2, "mean_followup": 240.0, "suppressed": False},

            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "M", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 10, "n_events": 3, "event_rate": 30.0, "mean_followup": 220.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "M", "period": "1年以上 (365日以上)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 10, "n_events": 3, "event_rate": 30.0, "mean_followup": 540.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "M", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "70+", "n_patients": None, "n_events": None, "event_rate": None, "mean_followup": None, "suppressed": True},

            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "F", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 7, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 28.6, "mean_followup": 210.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Active", "sex": "F", "period": "1年以上 (365日以上)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 7, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 28.6, "mean_followup": 530.0, "suppressed": False},

            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "M", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 5, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 40.0, "mean_followup": 215.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "M", "period": "1年以上 (365日以上)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 6, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 33.3, "mean_followup": 525.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "F", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "<55", "n_patients": 5, "n_events": 1, "event_rate": 20.0, "mean_followup": 235.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "F", "period": "1年以上 (365日以上)", "age_group": "<55", "n_patients": 5, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 40.0, "mean_followup": 535.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "F", "period": "<1年 (365日未満)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 7, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 28.6, "mean_followup": 220.0, "suppressed": False},
            {"treatment_arm": "Control", "sex": "F", "period": "1年以上 (365日以上)", "age_group": "55-69", "n_patients": 6, "n_events": 2, "event_rate": 33.3, "mean_followup": 540.0, "suppressed": False},
        ]
    }

raw_json = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
print(f'<script id="offline-cohort-data" type="application/json">{raw_json}</script>')
```

## 概要とセキュリティ保証

::: {.callout-note}
### 🛡️ 開示統制・完全自己完結（Offline-Ready）レポート
本報告書は、事前集計および開示統制（**5例未満マスキング・全集計値抑制・直接識別子除去**）が適用された安全なデータをもとに生成された完全自己完結型レポートです。

- **ダブルクリック（`file://`）起動対応**: 外部Webサーバー不要で、Microsoft Edge / Google Chrome で直接開いて動的に操作可能です。
- **外部通信ゼロ（完全オフライン）**: 外部CDN（unpkg/jsdelivr等）、リモートフォント、Web Worker、外部WASMを一切使用せず、院内閉域網環境でも安全に動作します。
:::

## 📋 集計データ一覧

```{=html}
<div class="card shadow-sm mb-4">
  <div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-striped table-hover mb-0" id="data-table">
      <thead class="table-dark">
        <tr>
          <th>治療群</th>
          <th>性別</th>
          <th>観察期間</th>
          <th>年齢層</th>
          <th class="text-end">患者数 (例)</th>
          <th class="text-end">イベント数</th>
          <th class="text-end">発生率 (%)</th>
          <th class="text-end">平均観察日数 (日)</th>
          <th class="text-center">開示統制状態</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="table-body">
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  // Pure local interactive dashboard logic (Zero external requests / Zero CDN / Zero WASM)
  const dataElement = document.getElementById("offline-cohort-data");
  if (!dataElement) return;

  let payload = { data: [] };
  try {
    payload = JSON.parse(dataElement.textContent || "{}");
  } catch(e) {
    console.error("Failed to parse cohort data JSON:", e);
    return;
  }

  const allRecords = payload.data || [];

  // Populate Filter Dropdowns (Arm, Sex, Period)
  const armSelect = document.getElementById("filter-arm");
  const sexSelect = document.getElementById("filter-sex");
  const periodSelect = document.getElementById("filter-period");
  const resetBtn = document.getElementById("btn-reset");

  if (!armSelect || !sexSelect || !periodSelect) return;

  const arms = Array.from(new Set(allRecords.map(d => d.treatment_arm))).filter(Boolean).sort();
  const sexes = Array.from(new Set(allRecords.map(d => d.sex))).filter(Boolean).sort();
  const periods = Array.from(new Set(allRecords.map(d => d.period))).filter(Boolean).sort();

  arms.forEach(arm => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = arm;
    opt.textContent = arm;
    armSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });

  sexes.forEach(s => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = s;
    opt.textContent = s === "M" ? "男性 (M)" : (s === "F" ? "女性 (F)" : s);
    sexSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });

  periods.forEach(p => {
    const opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = p;
    opt.textContent = p;
    periodSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });

  function getFilteredData() {
    const selectedArm = armSelect.value;
    const selectedSex = sexSelect.value;
    const selectedPeriod = periodSelect.value;
    return allRecords.filter(d => {
      const matchArm = selectedArm === "All" || d.treatment_arm === selectedArm;
      const matchSex = selectedSex === "All" || d.sex === selectedSex;
      const matchPeriod = selectedPeriod === "All" || d.period === selectedPeriod;
      return matchArm && matchSex && matchPeriod;
    });
  }

  function updateDashboard() {
    const filtered = getFilteredData();
    updateSummaryCards(filtered);
    renderChart(filtered);
    renderTable(filtered);
  }

  function updateSummaryCards(records) {
    let validPts = 0;
    let validEvents = 0;
    let totalFollowupDays = 0;
    let followupWeight = 0;

    records.forEach(r => {
      if (!r.suppressed && r.n_patients !== null) {
        validPts += r.n_patients;
        if (r.n_events !== null) validEvents += r.n_events;
        if (r.mean_followup !== null) {
          totalFollowupDays += (r.mean_followup * r.n_patients);
          followupWeight += r.n_patients;
        }
      }
    });

    const totalPtsEl = document.getElementById("stat-total-pts");
    const totalEventsEl = document.getElementById("stat-total-events");
    const avgRateEl = document.getElementById("stat-avg-rate");
    const avgFollowupEl = document.getElementById("stat-avg-followup");

    if (totalPtsEl) totalPtsEl.textContent = validPts > 0 ? `${validPts.toLocaleString()} 例` : "— (<5抑制)";
    if (totalEventsEl) totalEventsEl.textContent = validPts > 0 ? `${validEvents.toLocaleString()} 件` : "—";
    if (avgRateEl) avgRateEl.textContent = validPts > 0 ? `${((validEvents / validPts) * 100).toFixed(1)} %` : "—";
    if (avgFollowupEl) avgFollowupEl.textContent = followupWeight > 0 ? `${(totalFollowupDays / followupWeight).toFixed(1)} 日` : "—";
  }

  function renderTable(records) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById("table-body");
    if (!tbody) return;
    tbody.innerHTML = "";

    if (records.length === 0) {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      tr.innerHTML = '<td colspan="9" class="text-center text-muted py-3">該当する集計データがありません</td>';
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
      return;
    }

    records.forEach(r => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      if (r.suppressed) {
        tr.className = "table-warning text-muted";
      }

      const ptsText = r.suppressed || r.n_patients === null ? "— (<5抑制)" : r.n_patients;
      const eventsText = r.suppressed || r.n_events === null ? "—" : r.n_events;
      const rateText = r.suppressed || r.event_rate === null ? "—" : `${r.event_rate.toFixed(1)}%`;
      const followupText = r.suppressed || r.mean_followup === null ? "—" : `${r.mean_followup.toFixed(1)}日`;
      const statusBadge = r.suppressed
        ? '<span class="badge bg-warning text-dark">5例未満抑制</span>'
        : '<span class="badge bg-success">適合</span>';

      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td><strong>${escapeHtml(r.treatment_arm || "")}</strong></td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(r.sex === "M" ? "男性" : (r.sex === "F" ? "女性" : r.sex || ""))}</td>
        <td><span class="badge bg-light text-dark border">${escapeHtml(r.period || "全期間")}</span></td>
        <td>${escapeHtml(r.age_group || "")}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${ptsText}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${eventsText}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${rateText}</td>
        <td class="text-end">${followupText}</td>
        <td class="text-center">${statusBadge}</td>
      `;
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  }

  function renderChart(records) {
    const svg = document.getElementById("rwd-chart");
    const tooltip = document.getElementById("chart-tooltip");
    const container = document.getElementById("chart-container");
    if (!svg || !container) return;
    svg.innerHTML = "";

    const unsuppressed = records.filter(r => !r.suppressed && r.event_rate !== null);
    if (unsuppressed.length === 0) {
      const text = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      text.setAttribute("x", "50%");
      text.setAttribute("y", "50%");
      text.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      text.setAttribute("fill", "#6c757d");
      text.textContent = "表示可能な非抑制データがありません（5例未満マスキング適用中）";
      svg.appendChild(text);
      return;
    }

    const width = container.clientWidth || 750;
    const height = 300;
    const margin = { top: 30, right: 30, bottom: 50, left: 60 };
    const chartW = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const chartH = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);

    // Color palette for arms
    const colors = {
      "Active": "#0d6efd",
      "Control": "#dc3545",
      "Other": "#198754"
    };

    // Y Axis Grid & Labels (0 to 100%)
    for (let step = 0; step <= 100; step += 25) {
      const yPos = margin.top + chartH - (step / 100) * chartH;
      
      const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
      line.setAttribute("x1", margin.left);
      line.setAttribute("x2", margin.left + chartW);
      line.setAttribute("y1", yPos);
      line.setAttribute("y2", yPos);
      line.setAttribute("stroke", "#dee2e6");
      line.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", step === 0 ? "none" : "3,3");
      svg.appendChild(line);

      const yLabel = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      yLabel.setAttribute("x", margin.left - 10);
      yLabel.setAttribute("y", yPos + 4);
      yLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor", "end");
      yLabel.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
      yLabel.setAttribute("fill", "#6c757d");
      yLabel.textContent = `${step}%`;
      svg.appendChild(yLabel);
    }

    // X grouping by age_group + sex + (period if not single)
    const hasMultiplePeriods = new Set(unsuppressed.map(r => r.period)).size > 1;
    const categories = Array.from(new Set(unsuppressed.map(r => 
      hasMultiplePeriods ? `${r.age_group} (${r.sex}/${r.period})` : `${r.age_group} (${r.sex})`
    )));
    const catBand = chartW / (categories.length || 1);
    const barWidth = Math.min(36, (catBand * 0.7) / 2);

    categories.forEach((cat, cIdx) => {
      const catCenterX = margin.left + cIdx * catBand + catBand / 2;
      const catRecords = unsuppressed.filter(r => {
        const key = hasMultiplePeriods ? `${r.age_group} (${r.sex}/${r.period})` : `${r.age_group} (${r.sex})`;
        return key === cat;
      });

      catRecords.forEach((rec, rIdx) => {
        const offset = (rIdx - (catRecords.length - 1) / 2) * (barWidth + 4);
        const barX = catCenterX + offset - barWidth / 2;
        const rate = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, rec.event_rate || 0));
        const barH = (rate / 100) * chartH;
        const barY = margin.top + chartH - barH;

        const rect = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
        rect.setAttribute("x", barX);
        rect.setAttribute("y", barY);
        rect.setAttribute("width", barWidth);
        rect.setAttribute("height", barH);
        rect.setAttribute("rx", "3");
        rect.setAttribute("fill", colors[rec.treatment_arm] || "#6f42c1");
        rect.setAttribute("cursor", "pointer");

        // Tooltip interactions
        rect.addEventListener("mouseenter", (evt) => {
          if (!tooltip) return;
          tooltip.style.display = "block";
          tooltip.innerHTML = `
            <strong>群: ${escapeHtml(rec.treatment_arm)}</strong><br/>
            期間: ${escapeHtml(rec.period || "")}<br/>
            層: ${escapeHtml(rec.age_group)} / ${escapeHtml(rec.sex)}<br/>
            発生率: <strong>${rec.event_rate.toFixed(1)}%</strong><br/>
            イベント数: ${rec.n_events} / ${rec.n_patients} 例
          `;
          const rectBox = container.getBoundingClientRect();
          tooltip.style.left = `${evt.clientX - rectBox.left + 12}px`;
          tooltip.style.top = `${evt.clientY - rectBox.top - 20}px`;
        });
        rect.addEventListener("mousemove", (evt) => {
          if (!tooltip) return;
          const rectBox = container.getBoundingClientRect();
          tooltip.style.left = `${evt.clientX - rectBox.left + 12}px`;
          tooltip.style.top = `${evt.clientY - rectBox.top - 20}px`;
        });
        rect.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
          if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = "none";
        });

        svg.appendChild(rect);
      });

      // Category X label
      const xLabel = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      xLabel.setAttribute("x", catCenterX);
      xLabel.setAttribute("y", margin.top + chartH + 20);
      xLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
      xLabel.setAttribute("font-size", hasMultiplePeriods ? "10" : "12");
      xLabel.setAttribute("fill", "#495057");
      xLabel.textContent = cat;
      svg.appendChild(xLabel);
    });
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    if (typeof str !== "string") return String(str);
    return str.replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => ({
      "&": "&amp;",
      "<": "&lt;",
      ">": "&gt;",
      '"': "&quot;",
      "'": "&#039;"
    }[m]));
  }

  if (armSelect) armSelect.addEventListener("change", updateDashboard);
  if (sexSelect) sexSelect.addEventListener("change", updateDashboard);
  if (periodSelect) periodSelect.addEventListener("change", updateDashboard);
  if (resetBtn) {
    resetBtn.addEventListener("click", function() {
      armSelect.value = "All";
      sexSelect.value = "All";
      periodSelect.value = "All";
      updateDashboard();
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
    renderChart(getFilteredData());
  });

  // Initial render
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateDashboard);
  } else {
    updateDashboard();
  }
})();
</script>
```
